svg.title: Alertmanager redacted placeholder
svg.desc: Safe placeholder template for a redacted Alertmanager screenshot.
svg.text: Prefer Alerts/Silences views on sanitized data. Status/config can expose routes, receivers, internal addresses, and service URLs.

g.text: REDACTED: receiver names, routes, cluster peers, internal IPs/URLs
REDACTED: alert labels/annotations, instance/job targets, secrets/config
SAFE: use demo data or crop to non-sensitive UI chrome if necessary

svg.text: ⚠ Do not capture /api/v2/status or config views from live instances without strict redaction review.
